parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
  SELECT * FROM json_to_recordset(convert_from(decode($1, 'base64'), 'UTF8')::json) AS x(
    source text, event_id text, event_type text, email_hash text, email_domain text, occurred_at timestamptz, provider_message_id text, detail jsonb, run_id text)
), meta AS (
  SELECT (convert_from(decode($2, 'base64'), 'UTF8')::json->>'dry_run')::boolean AS dry, (convert_from(decode($2, 'base64'), 'UTF8')::json->>'soft_window_days')::int AS days
), ins AS (
  INSERT INTO feedback_events (source, event_id, event_type, email_hash, email_domain, occurred_at, provider_message_id, detail, run_id)
  SELECT source, event_id, event_type, email_hash, email_domain, occurred_at, provider_message_id, COALESCE(detail, '{}'::jsonb), run_id
    FROM input WHERE NOT (SELECT dry FROM meta)
  ON CONFLICT (source, event_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id, source, event_id
), prior AS (
  SELECT f.email_hash, count(*) AS n
    FROM feedback_events f
   WHERE f.event_type = 'soft_bounce'
     AND f.occurred_at > now() - make_interval(days => (SELECT days FROM meta))
     AND f.email_hash IN (SELECT email_hash FROM input)
   GROUP BY f.email_hash
)
SELECT i.source, i.event_id, i.email_hash,
       CASE WHEN (SELECT dry FROM meta)
            THEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM feedback_events f WHERE f.source = i.source AND f.event_id = i.event_id)
            ELSE ins.id IS NOT NULL END AS is_new,
       ins.id AS event_row_id,
       COALESCE(p.n, 0) AS prior_soft_bounces,
       CASE WHEN s.quarantined THEN s.reason END AS suppressed_reason,
       c.overall_status AS sync_status
  FROM input i
  LEFT JOIN ins ON ins.source = i.source AND ins.event_id = i.event_id
  LEFT JOIN prior p ON p.email_hash = i.email_hash
  LEFT JOIN email_suppression s ON s.email_hash = i.email_hash
  LEFT JOIN contact_sync_state c ON c.email_hash = i.email_hash;

UPDATE contact_sync_state s
   SET claimed_at = now()
 WHERE s.email_hash IN (
       SELECT email_hash FROM contact_sync_state
        WHERE email IS NOT NULL
          AND ((overall_status = 'pending' AND next_attempt_at <= now()) OR unsubscribe_state = 'approved')
          AND (claimed_at IS NULL OR claimed_at < now() - interval '30 minutes')
        ORDER BY updated_at
        LIMIT $1::int
        FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED)
RETURNING s.email_hash, s.email, s.email_domain, s.severity, s.reasons, s.sources, s.hubspot_contact_id, s.hubspot_status,
          s.sendgrid_status, s.ses_status, s.webhook_status, s.unsubscribe_state, s.attempts;

parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
  SELECT * FROM json_to_recordset(convert_from(decode($1, 'base64'), 'UTF8')::json) AS x(
    email_hash text, email_domain text, email text, severity text, reasons jsonb, sources jsonb, event_row_ids jsonb, quarantine boolean,
    hubspot_contact_id text, hubspot_status text, sendgrid_status text, ses_status text, webhook_status text, unsubscribe_state text,
    overall_status text, last_error text, reset_attempts boolean)
), meta AS (SELECT convert_from(decode($2, 'base64'), 'UTF8')::json AS j
), fresh AS (SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM feedback_runs r WHERE r.run_id = (SELECT j->>'run_id' FROM meta)) AS ok
), sup AS (
  INSERT INTO email_suppression AS es (email_hash, email_domain, reason, sources, event_count)
  SELECT email_hash, email_domain, severity, ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(sources)), jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(event_row_ids, '[]'::jsonb))
    FROM input WHERE quarantine AND (SELECT ok FROM fresh)
  ON CONFLICT (email_hash) DO UPDATE
     SET last_seen_at = now(),
         reason = CASE WHEN feedback_severity_rank(EXCLUDED.reason) >= feedback_severity_rank(es.reason) THEN EXCLUDED.reason ELSE es.reason END,
         sources = ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT unnest(es.sources || EXCLUDED.sources)),
         event_count = es.event_count + EXCLUDED.event_count,
         quarantined = true, released_at = NULL, released_by = NULL, release_note = NULL
  RETURNING 1
), st AS (
  INSERT INTO contact_sync_state AS cs (email_hash, email_domain, email, severity, reasons, sources, hubspot_contact_id, hubspot_status, sendgrid_status,
                                        ses_status, webhook_status, unsubscribe_state, overall_status, attempts, last_error, next_attempt_at, claimed_at, updated_at)
  SELECT email_hash, email_domain, email, severity, ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(reasons)), ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(sources)),
         hubspot_contact_id, hubspot_status, sendgrid_status, ses_status, webhook_status, unsubscribe_state, overall_status, CASE WHEN reset_attempts THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, last_error,
         now() + make_interval(mins => (SELECT (j->>'retry_minutes')::int FROM meta)), NULL, now()
    FROM input WHERE (SELECT ok FROM fresh)
  ON CONFLICT (email_hash) DO UPDATE
     SET email = EXCLUDED.email,
         email_domain = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.email_domain, cs.email_domain),
         severity = CASE WHEN feedback_severity_rank(EXCLUDED.severity) >= feedback_severity_rank(cs.severity) THEN EXCLUDED.severity ELSE cs.severity END,
         reasons = ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT unnest(cs.reasons || EXCLUDED.reasons)),
         sources = ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT unnest(cs.sources || EXCLUDED.sources)),
         hubspot_contact_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.hubspot_contact_id, cs.hubspot_contact_id),
         hubspot_status = EXCLUDED.hubspot_status, sendgrid_status = EXCLUDED.sendgrid_status,
         ses_status = EXCLUDED.ses_status, webhook_status = EXCLUDED.webhook_status,
         unsubscribe_state = CASE WHEN cs.unsubscribe_state = 'applied' THEN 'applied' ELSE EXCLUDED.unsubscribe_state END,
         attempts = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.attempts = 1 THEN 1 ELSE cs.attempts + 1 END,
         overall_status = CASE
           WHEN EXCLUDED.overall_status = 'pending'
            AND (CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.attempts = 1 THEN 1 ELSE cs.attempts + 1 END)
                >= (SELECT (j->>'max_attempts')::int FROM meta)
           THEN 'failed' ELSE EXCLUDED.overall_status END,
         last_error = EXCLUDED.last_error,
         next_attempt_at = now() + LEAST(interval '24 hours',
           make_interval(mins => (SELECT (j->>'retry_minutes')::int FROM meta)) * power(2, LEAST(10, cs.attempts))::int),
         claimed_at = NULL, updated_at = now(),
         reviewed_by = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.unsubscribe_state = 'pending_review' AND cs.unsubscribe_state <> 'pending_review' THEN NULL ELSE cs.reviewed_by END
  RETURNING 1
), ev AS (
  UPDATE feedback_events f
     SET sync_status = i.overall_status, synced_at = CASE WHEN i.overall_status = 'done' THEN now() END
    FROM input i, jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(i.event_row_ids, '[]'::jsonb)) AS e(id)
   WHERE f.id = e.id::bigint AND (SELECT ok FROM fresh)
  RETURNING 1
), run AS (
  INSERT INTO feedback_runs (run_id, origin, mode, started_at, counts)
  SELECT j->>'run_id', j->>'origin', j->>'mode', (j->>'started_at')::timestamptz, j->'counts' FROM meta
  ON CONFLICT (run_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING 1
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM sup) AS suppression_upserts, (SELECT count(*) FROM st) AS sync_rows,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM ev) AS events_updated, (SELECT count(*) FROM run) AS run_rows;

parameters.content:
## n8n-smtp-relay-bounce-complaint-feedback-loop
SES / SendGrid / Postfix feedback → verify → normalize & hash → record (idempotent) → quarantine in HubSpot → unsubscribe (review or apply) → SendGrid / SES / webhook suppression → PostgreSQL. DH Robin · dhRobin Systems.

**Safe defaults:** `SANDBOX_MODE=true`, `DRY_RUN=true`, `CONSENT_CHANGE_MODE=review`. Sandbox makes no external calls; dry run reads HubSpot and PostgreSQL but writes nothing.

**Stage 1** Execute each webhook and the retry trigger with their pinned fictional data.
**Stage 2** `SANDBOX_MODE=false`: staging HubSpot portal + staging database, writes simulated.
**Stage 3** `DRY_RUN=false`: properties, suppressions and state are written. Unsubscribes wait for approval until you set `CONSENT_CHANGE_MODE=apply`.

### Acknowledge after recording
Providers get 200 only once the event is stored; a database error answers 500 so SNS / SendGrid retry.

### Sanitized error path
No stack traces, headers or bodies. Tokens, AWS keys, database passwords and webhook URLs are redacted.
